verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a dedicated secret-detection tool that scans git history, directories, and stdin for hardcoded passwords, API keys, and tokens. Dependency vulnerability (SCA) alerting with reachability analysis belongs to a different product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Gitleaks analyzes dependencies at all, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can prioritize dependency alerts by whether the vulnerable code is actually reachable from my code
